_comment: Club (FSCA) ring card — a Finnish Spitz exhibitor's cheat sheet for the whole event. myBreeds is the priority list (Finnish Spitz first, always highlighted); add breeds here if you're also showing them. No 'otherBreeds' / cross-breed clash machinery. Groups are NOT filtered so the full end-of-day order shows for both Regular and Owner-Handled, with the group(s) your breeds are in highlighted. Pair with template-club.html.
